title: The Lighthouse Letters
blurb: A keeper's daughter waits on the harbour wall for a boat that does not come, and the letters in the lighthouse tell her which way to row.

choiceTexts.3:0: Take the letter to the keeper

endings.2: bittersweet: the boat is found, empty
endings.4: hopeful: the boat turns for home

beats.ch01.s01.b001: Rain needles the grey water. The lighthouse beam sweeps over the boats.
beats.ch01.s01.b003: He said he'd be back before the lamp was lit.
beats.ch01.s01.b005: The sea keeps its own time, girl.
beats.ch02.s01.b001: Morning comes grey and quiet. The boat is not there.
beats.ch02.s01.b004: Far out, a hull turns over in the swell.
beats.ch03.s01.b001: The lamp is cold. A letter lies on the logbook.
beats.ch03.s01.b003: It is addressed to the keeper.
beats.ch03.s01.b005: The letter says the boat turned south before the storm.
beats.ch03.s01.b006: Then the lamp can call it back.
beats.ch04.s01.b001: The brass lamp burns bright and the beam reaches the dark water.
beats.ch04.s01.b003: You kept your time after all.
beats.ch04.s01.b005: Far out, a small boat turns for home.
